nameForms.name: Margraviate of Flanders
nameForms.note: The early Flemish territory was held as a margraviate before the comital title became customary.
nameForms.noteCn: 早期佛兰德领地以侯国形式存在，后来伯爵头衔成为惯例。

nameForms.name: County of Flanders
nameForms.note: The comital designation became standard for the Flemish succession.
nameForms.noteCn: 伯国称谓成为佛兰德继承体系的标准名称。

holders.note: Established the Flemish margraviate through his marriage to Judith.
holders.noteCn: 通过与朱迪丝的婚姻确立佛兰德侯国。

holders.note: Succeeded Baldwin II as the Flemish ruler.
holders.noteCn: 继承鲍德温二世，成为佛兰德统治者。

holders.note: Ruled jointly with his father Arnulf I.
holders.noteCn: 与父亲阿努尔夫一世共同统治。

holders.note: Succeeded to the Flemish county after the joint-rule generation.
holders.noteCn: 在共同统治的一代之后继承佛兰德伯国。
继承其父阿努尔夫二世。

holders.note: Succeeded Baldwin IV and became Matilda of Flanders's father.
holders.noteCn: 继承鲍德温四世，并成为佛兰德的玛蒂尔达之父。

holders.note: A short succession crisis followed Baldwin VI's death.
holders.noteCn: 鲍德温六世去世后出现短暂继承危机。
holders.sideNote: The county passed to Robert I after the succession conflict.
holders.sideNoteCn: 继承冲突后，伯国转入罗贝尔一世手中。

holders.note: Succeeded after the succession conflict of 1071.
holders.noteCn: 在1071年继承冲突后继承伯国。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Robert I and joined the First Crusade.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父罗贝尔一世，并参加第一次十字军东征。

holders.note: Succeeded Robert II and died without a surviving heir.
holders.noteCn: 继承罗贝尔二世，去世时没有存活的继承人。

holders.note: A Danish prince selected as count after Baldwin VII's death.
holders.noteCn: 鲍德温七世去世后，由丹麦王子继任伯爵。

holders.note: Installed with French support after Charles the Good's murder, but faced a rival claim.
holders.noteCn: 善良的查理遇害后，在法国支持下继任，但面对竞争性继承主张。

holders.note: Won the succession struggle and began the Alsatian line.
holders.noteCn: 赢得继承斗争，开启阿尔萨斯王朝支系。

holders.note: Succeeded Thierry of Alsace and held the county until his death on crusade.
holders.noteCn: 继承阿尔萨斯的蒂埃里，直至十字军东征期间去世。
